rules.description: Primary high-contrast color used for base text, underline states, and premium product card surfaces.
when_to_use: Background fill for standout product cards ('field system', 'OB-4')

rules.description: A deep, near-black ink used heavily for navigation, footers, and large architectural blocks.
when_to_use: Header navigation icons and text fills
Footer and mobile menu background fill
Text for specific product titles (e.g., 'pocket operator')

rules.description: A mid-tone gray utilized for secondary information, muted icons, and subtle interactive elements.
when_to_use: Product titles on black cards ('field system', 'OB-4')

rules.description: The foundational bright palette defining the page canvas, distinct card surfaces, and inverted typography.
when_to_use: Inverted text on dark footer and product cards
Mobile menu text and Japanese footer text

rules.description: The sole vibrant accent color in the entire design, strictly reserved for driving conversions.
when_to_use: 'Buy now' action links on product cards

insights: The palette is starkly minimalist and strictly monochromatic, relying on pure black, off-whites, and grays to let the product photography stand out.
Surface hierarchy is achieved without borders; instead, subtle off-white and light gray tints separate standard product cards from the pure white page background.
By restricting color almost entirely, the single vivid blue creates an undeniable focal point specifically tailored to purchasing actions.
